info.title: CF Meet Privacy Relay API
info.description: The CF Meet platform Privacy Relay API (Part D sections 26-36): Communication Contexts, Privacy Relay Sessions and the Contact Vault. One generic model for first-party and external applications alike; it never knows a consumer's business object. Privacy Relay (services/privacy-relay) is the business and data authority; the API is currently served by the authenticated platform ingress (services/calling), which authenticates the customer credential, checks the scope, validates referenced principals and forwards over authenticated internal service calls with a signed delegated platform context — the customer credential is never forwarded. Tenant, application and environment come only from the credential; a resource of another scope is answered exactly like a missing one (404). Every mutation requires expectedVersion where it changes an existing resource and an Idempotency-Key (a replay returns the recorded response with Idempotent-Replayed: true; a different request under the same key is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT). Lifecycle changes are explicit commands; there is no status patch. The Contact Vault routes (x-cfmeet-served-by: cfmeet.privacy-relay) are served by Privacy Relay itself and authenticated by a short-lived Contact Vault access token minted by Calling (POST /v1/privacy-relay/contact-access-grants), so a raw telephone number never transits Calling; they are the ONLY routes that accept a telephone number (telephoneNumber), and no route ever returns one. No provider id, carrier, Contact Vault ciphertext, fingerprint, key or credential is ever accepted or returned.

post.description: Creates a Communication Context (version 1): the consumer-neutral authority for WHY (opaque externalContextReference), WHO (participants: principal ids or opaque ContactReference ids), in which DIRECTION, over which CHANNEL, during which window and under which bounded policy parties may communicate. Requires privacy.contexts.write and an Idempotency-Key. Referenced principals must be active principals of the credential's own application environment. Scope comes only from the credential; status, version, authorization results, telephone numbers, providers and relay numbers are never inputs. One context per external reference in an application environment. 503 PRIVACY_RELAY_DISABLED while the feature is disabled.

201.description: The created context (or the recorded result of an identical earlier request).

get.description: Contexts of the credential's application environment, newest first, keyset-paginated (no offsets). Requires privacy.contexts.read.
Requires privacy.contexts.read. A context of another tenant, application or environment is answered exactly like a missing one (404 CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND).

patch.description: Typed, versioned configuration update (participant replacement / reassignment on the SAME context, channels, directions, validity, bounded policy, allowed strategies) — never a status patch or an arbitrary merge patch. Requires privacy.contexts.write, expectedVersion (409 CONTEXT_VERSION_CONFLICT when stale; a stale write can never restore removed authority) and an Idempotency-Key. The version increments exactly once; removed participants lose authority the moment the update commits, in every relay session; active calls of removed participants are terminated when the policy says so (enforcement.status APPLIED or PENDING, never claimed early).

get.description: Lifecycle, versions, participant and direction history, sessions, recent authorization decisions, audit events and enforcement status for support and debugging. Never contact values. Requires privacy.contexts.read.

post.description: Explicit lifecycle command (no status patch). Requires privacy.contexts.write, expectedVersion and an Idempotency-Key. ACTIVE -> SUSPENDED: new authority is denied immediately; active calls are terminated when terminateActiveCallsOnSuspend.

200.description: The command result (or the recorded result of an identical earlier request).

post.description: Explicit lifecycle command (no status patch). Requires privacy.contexts.write, expectedVersion and an Idempotency-Key. SUSPENDED -> ACTIVE, only while the validity window remains and never from COMPLETED, REVOKED or EXPIRED.

200.description: The command result (or the recorded result of an identical earlier request).

post.description: Explicit lifecycle command (no status patch). Requires privacy.contexts.write, expectedVersion and an Idempotency-Key. -> COMPLETED (never back to ACTIVE): relay sessions complete; new calls during the grace period only when graceAllowsNewCalls; without remaining grace active calls are terminated; after the final grace all authority ends.

200.description: The command result (or the recorded result of an identical earlier request).

post.description: Explicit lifecycle command (no status patch). Requires privacy.contexts.write, expectedVersion and an Idempotency-Key. -> REVOKED (terminal, irreversible): every relay session is revoked, all new authority is denied, active calls are terminated when terminateActiveCallsOnRevoke. Repeating it is a safe idempotent answer.

200.description: The command result (or the recorded result of an identical earlier request).

post.description: Creates a Privacy Relay Session (NOT a call: one session may authorize many call attempts during its window) under a relay strategy. Requires privacy.sessions.write and an Idempotency-Key. Participants, channels, directions, validity and strategy may only NARROW the context; anything broader is refused (PARTICIPANT_NOT_AUTHORIZED, CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED, DIRECTION_NOT_ALLOWED, STRATEGY_NOT_ALLOWED, VALIDITY_NOT_CONTAINED). Strategies are policy: only the application route is executable today.

get.description: Sessions of the credential's application environment, newest first, keyset-paginated. Requires privacy.sessions.read.
Requires privacy.sessions.read. A session of another scope is answered exactly like a missing one (404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND).

post.description: Explicit lifecycle command (no status patch). Requires privacy.sessions.write, expectedVersion and an Idempotency-Key. New authority under this session is denied immediately.

200.description: The command result (or the recorded result of an identical earlier request).

post.description: Explicit lifecycle command (no status patch). Requires privacy.sessions.write, expectedVersion and an Idempotency-Key. Only within the session window and while its context is not terminal.

200.description: The command result (or the recorded result of an identical earlier request).

post.description: Explicit lifecycle command (no status patch). Requires privacy.sessions.write, expectedVersion and an Idempotency-Key. Terminal; active protected calls under the session are terminated when the context policy says so.

200.description: The command result (or the recorded result of an identical earlier request).

post.summary: Mint a Contact Vault access token
post.description: Served by Calling. Authenticates the platform credential and returns a short-lived Contact Vault access token for the requested privacy.contacts.* scopes; the credential must itself hold every requested scope (403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE otherwise). The body never contains a telephone number. 503 when Contact Vault delegated access is not configured.

The ONLY public entry point of a raw telephone number. Canonicalizes it to E.164 (libphonenumber metadata; malformed, ambiguous, URI or extension input is 422 CONTACT_INVALID), encrypts it with AES-256-GCM bound to the scope and ContactReference, stores only ciphertext and safe metadata, writes the contact access audit and returns the safe contact (UNVERIFIED). Requires privacy.contacts.write. 503 CONTACT_VAULT_DISABLED while the Contact Vault is disabled or not configured. The request body is never logged.

201.description: The created (or, within the same application environment, the existing) safe contact.

get.description: Requires privacy.contacts.read. Returns only the safe representation; every read is audited.

patch.description: Requires privacy.contacts.write and expectedVersion (409 CONTACT_VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise). The same ContactReference gets the new canonical value under the active key, version + 1, and verification UNVERIFIED (a changed number is never still verified). The request body is never logged.

post.description: Requires privacy.contacts.write and expectedVersion. A disabled contact is never resolved or newly referenced. Restrictive: allowed while the Contact Vault is disabled. Repeating it on a disabled contact returns the contact.

Requires a Contact Vault access token with privacy.contacts.verify (privacy.contacts.write is not enough) and expectedVersion. Records a bounded trust source and an opaque evidence reference (never evidence JSON); appends the verification history and the access audit. VERIFIED may carry validUntil, after which the contact is EXPIRED at read time. BLOCKED / INVALID contacts are never resolved, whatever their history. Restrictive targets are accepted while the Contact Vault is disabled.

200.description: The safe contact after the assertion.

get.summary: Privacy-safe call evidence of a Relay Session
get.description: Requires privacy.evidence.read (knowing a session id is never enough). Calling verifies with Privacy Relay, in the credential's scope, that the session exists for the caller — a session of another scope is exactly 404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND — then returns evidence from its OWN Call records: canonical timestamps, final state, normalized terminal reason and failure category, Calling's authoritative connected duration (never requestedAt -> endedAt), per-participant connected time, attempts, route class and the Privacy Relay decision ids. NO_ANSWER comes from the canonical Call record (independent of push delivery). Never a telephone number, masked number, Contact Vault material, provider / carrier identifier, provider payload or credential. Keyset pages (limit 1-100, default 25); 503 when ownership cannot be proven.

platformCredential.description: Customer platform API credential (Authorization: Bearer). The roles in an operation's security requirement are the platform scopes the credential must hold (privacy.contexts.read / .write, privacy.sessions.read / .write, privacy.evidence.read).

contactDelegation.name: X-CF-Contact-Authorization
contactDelegation.description: Contact Vault access token: "Bearer <compact JWS>" (typ cf-contact-access+jwt) from POST /v1/privacy-relay/contact-access-grants, at most 300 s old. The roles are the Contact Vault scopes the token must carry. A customer Authorization header, a service token or a token for another audience / runtime environment is refused (401 CONTACT_DELEGATION_INVALID); a missing scope is 403 CONTACT_SCOPE_DENIED.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: idempotency-key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Required on every mutation. Same key + same request: recorded response; different request: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; concurrent duplicates take effect once.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor (nextCursor of the previous page).

ContactReference.name: contact_reference
ContactReference.description: ContactReference. A contact of another tenant, application or environment is answered exactly like a missing one (404 CONTACT_NOT_FOUND).

IdempotentReplayed.description: true when the response replays an earlier identical request.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed or invalid request (VALIDATION_ERROR): unknown members (a tenantId, status, version, authorization result, telephone number, provider or arbitrary policy document is refused), invalid validity, missing Idempotency-Key, inactive or foreign principals.

NotFound.description: CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND / SESSION_NOT_FOUND / NOT_FOUND — identical for missing and foreign resources.

Conflict.description: CONTEXT_VERSION_CONFLICT, SESSION_VERSION_CONFLICT, CONTEXT_REFERENCE_CONFLICT, CONTEXT_NOT_ACTIVE, CONTEXT_EXPIRED, CONTEXT_REVOKED, CONTEXT_SUSPENDED, SESSION_NOT_ACTIVE or IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

Unprocessable.description: The request would broaden authority: PARTICIPANT_NOT_AUTHORIZED, DIRECTION_NOT_ALLOWED, CHANNEL_NOT_ALLOWED, STRATEGY_NOT_ALLOWED or VALIDITY_NOT_CONTAINED.

privacy-relay.common.v1.AuditEventType.description: Immutable Privacy Relay evidence event types.

privacy-relay.common.v1.AuthorizationPur.description: Safe intent metadata of an authorization request.

privacy-relay.common.v1.AuthorizationRea.description: Normalized platform reason of a decision (no consumer-specific reasons).

privacy-relay.common.v1.CommunicationCha.description: Communication channel. VOICE is executed; MESSAGING may be declared for the future and is never executed by sections 26-30 (no chat, SMS or provider messaging).

privacy-relay.common.v1.CommunicationCon.description: Lifecycle of a Communication Context. REVOKED and EXPIRED are terminal; COMPLETED never returns to ACTIVE or SUSPENDED.

privacy-relay.common.v1.CommunicationRou.description: Route an authorization asks for. Only APPLICATION is executable today.

privacy-relay.common.v1.ContactReference.description: Opaque, server-generated ContactReference (UUID) of a protected contact, scoped to one tenant / application / environment. It never encodes a number, country, provider or user; knowing it grants nothing.

privacy-relay.common.v1.ContactVerificat.description: Verification state of a protected contact (Part D section 33). UNVERIFIED on creation and after every telephone-value change; only a trusted verification integration (privacy.contacts.verify) asserts PENDING / VERIFIED / INVALID / BLOCKED; a VERIFIED contact whose validity has passed is EXPIRED at read time. INVALID and BLOCKED contacts are never resolved for execution.

privacy-relay.common.v1.ContextPolicy.description: The typed, bounded context policy (never an arbitrary document). Defaults are fail-safe.

terminateActiveCallsOnRevoke.description: On revoke, actively terminate protected calls (new authority is denied regardless).

terminateActiveCallsOnParticipantRemoval.description: On participant removal, terminate protected calls involving the removed participant; when false they may continue but no new protected call or transfer involving that participant is authorized.

terminateActiveCallsOnSuspend.description: On suspend, terminate protected calls (new authority is denied regardless).

graceAllowsNewCalls.description: Whether new calls may be authorized during the completion grace period.

privacy-relay.common.v1.DirectionPolicy.description: BIDIRECTIONAL: any two active participants, both directions. EXPLICIT: only directed edges authorize; A -> B never implies B -> A.

privacy-relay.common.v1.DirectionRequest.description: A directed edge between two subjects; channel restricts it to one channel (absent: every allowed channel).

privacy-relay.common.v1.Enforcement.description: Active-call enforcement of a mutation (event ids of the durable enforcement jobs it created).

privacy-relay.common.v1.EnforcementReaso.description: Why active protected calls are enforced against.

privacy-relay.common.v1.EnforcementState.description: Active-call enforcement state of a mutation: NOT_REQUIRED, PENDING (durably queued; Calling has not confirmed) or APPLIED (Calling confirmed). Never claimed before Calling confirms.

privacy-relay.common.v1.ErrorCode.description: Stable error codes of the Privacy Relay API. AUTHENTICATION_FAILED, INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE and RATE_LIMITED come from the authenticated platform ingress; INTERNAL_* only from internal routes (never relayed to customers).

privacy-relay.common.v1.ErrorEnvelope.description: Error response body: stable code, fixed safe message, server request id. Never database errors, foreign-resource existence, tokens or contact data.

privacy-relay.common.v1.ExternalContextR.description: Consumer-defined, opaque, bounded reference of the business relationship (CF Meet never parses it). It can never be contact data: no telephone number, e-mail address or tel / sip / mailto URI.

privacy-relay.common.v1.IdempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key: 1-255 printable ASCII characters without spaces.

privacy-relay.common.v1.MaskedTelephoneD.description: Bounded masked display of a protected number: "+" and the country calling code, six bullets, and at most the last four national digits (fewer for short numbers; at least six national digits always stay hidden).

privacy-relay.common.v1.PrivacyRelaySess.description: Lifecycle of a Privacy Relay Session (same graph as contexts); a session never outlives its context's authority.

privacy-relay.common.v1.RelayStrategy.description: Relay strategy: policy, not proof that a route exists. Every strategy permits the application route; the public-network and callback strategies only become executable when relay-number and telephony infrastructure exists.

privacy-relay.common.v1.SnapshotScope.description: Whether a relay session follows its context (INHERITED) or was explicitly narrowed (NARROWED).

privacy-relay.common.v1.SubjectReference.description: Exactly one opaque subject reference: a CF Meet principal id or an opaque ContactReference id. A ContactReference is never a telephone number, e-mail address or SIP URI, and Privacy Relay never resolves it (Contact Vault is a later section).

privacy-relay.common.v1.Version.description: Monotonic version (starts at 1, +1 per accepted authority change).

privacy-relay.contact-delegation.v1.Cont.description: A short-lived (default 120 s, at most 300 s) Contact Vault access token, returned once (Cache-Control: no-store).
POST /v1/privacy-relay/contact-access-grants (platform credential). Contains no telephone number.
Contact Vault scopes. A credential can delegate only scopes it holds, and Privacy Relay accepts only scopes its contact delegation trust bundle allows the issuer to delegate.

privacy-relay.contact.v1.CreateContactRe.description: Protect a telephone number (Contact Vault access token with privacy.contacts.write). Verification, status, fingerprints, key versions and scope are not inputs.

telephoneNumber.description: The raw telephone number: E.164 ("+…") or a national number with defaultCountry. Digits and spaces, "+", "-", ".", "(" and ")" only (no URI scheme, extension or letters). This member exists ONLY in the Contact Vault raw-input bodies; it is never returned and never accepted by any other CF Meet API.

defaultCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used only to canonicalize a number written without the international prefix.

privacy-relay.contact.v1.DisableContactR.description: Disable a contact (restrictive; allowed while the Contact Vault is disabled).

privacy-relay.contact.v1.ProtectedContac.description: The SAFE representation of a protected contact: never the number, ciphertext, nonce, fingerprint or key version.

voice.description: Voice capability; UNKNOWN unless a trusted source established it (never inferred from syntax).

privacy-relay.contact.v1.UpdateContactRe.description: Replace the telephone value of a contact (same ContactReference, version + 1, verification reset to UNVERIFIED).

telephoneNumber.description: The raw telephone number: E.164 ("+…") or a national number with defaultCountry. Digits and spaces, "+", "-", ".", "(" and ")" only (no URI scheme, extension or letters). This member exists ONLY in the Contact Vault raw-input bodies; it is never returned and never accepted by any other CF Meet API.

defaultCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country used only to canonicalize a number written without the international prefix.

privacy-relay.contact.v1.VerificationAss.description: A trusted verification assertion (Contact Vault access token with privacy.contacts.verify). validUntil only with VERIFIED (at most 366 days); restrictive targets (UNVERIFIED, INVALID, BLOCKED) are accepted while the Contact Vault is disabled.

trustSource.description: Bounded code of the trusted source (e.g. OTP_PROVIDER, MANUAL_REVIEW, FRAUD_REVIEW).

evidenceReference.description: Opaque reference to evidence held by the verifier (never the evidence itself, a number, address or URI).

privacy-relay.context.v1.CommunicationCo.description: Safe representation of a Communication Context. Never a telephone number, provider id, carrier, Contact Vault material, service token or customer credential.

effectiveStatus.description: Status at read time: EXPIRED once the final validity has passed, even before the expiry worker materializes it.

privacy-relay.context.v1.ContextEvidence.description: Privacy-safe support evidence: lifecycle, versions, participant and direction history, sessions, recent decisions, audit events and enforcement status. No contact values.

privacy-relay.context.v1.CreateContextRe.description: Create a Communication Context (Idempotency-Key required). Scope comes only from the authenticated credential; status, version, authorization results, telephone numbers, providers and relay numbers are not inputs.

directions.description: Required (non-empty) with EXPLICIT; refused with BIDIRECTIONAL.

privacy-relay.context.v1.LifecycleComman.description: Body of an explicit lifecycle command (suspend, resume, complete, revoke). Idempotency-Key required.

privacy-relay.context.v1.UpdateContextRe.description: Typed, versioned configuration update (never a status patch or arbitrary merge patch). Absent members are unchanged; participants and directions replace the whole set (participant reassignment keeps the same context). At least one change is required.

privacy-relay.events.v1.EventData.description: Bounded safe evidence: snake_case keys never naming secrets or contact data; ids, versions, counts, statuses.

privacy-relay.evidence.v1.CallEvidence.description: Privacy-safe support / dispute evidence of one protected Call, from Calling's own records. Never a telephone number (raw or masked), Contact Vault material, provider / carrier identifier, provider payload, SIP dialog or credential.

oneOf.description: CF Meet normalized failure category (never a vendor status).
Calling's authoritative connected time (first CONNECTED to the end, or durationsAsOf); null when never connected. Never requestedAt -> endedAt.

privacy-relay.evidence.v1.EvidenceAttemp.description: One attempt: timing and normalized outcome only (no provider, route secret or destination).

oneOf.description: CF Meet normalized failure category (never a vendor status).

privacy-relay.evidence.v1.EvidenceDecisi.description: A Privacy Relay authorization the Call relied on (ids and versions only).

connectedDurationMs.description: Union of the participant's session connection intervals.

privacy-relay.evidence.v1.PrivacyRelayEv.description: GET /v1/privacy-relay/sessions/{relay_session_id}/evidence: the protected Calls of one Relay Session (newest first, keyset pages of at most 100).

privacy-relay.session.v1.CreateSessionRe.description: Create a Privacy Relay Session of a context (Idempotency-Key required). Everything except relayStrategy is optional and can only NARROW the context (participants, channels, directions, validity, a strategy among the context's allowed strategies). A relay identity or telephone number is never an input.

privacy-relay.session.v1.PrivacyRelaySes.description: Safe representation of a Privacy Relay Session (NOT a call; one session may authorize many call attempts). relayIdentityBindingRef is opaque and server-owned (never a number, carrier or provider resource).

executableRoutes.description: Routes the strategy permits that CF Meet can execute today.
